title: USP Calendar Free/Busy Extension
description: Calendar free/busy extension schema for the Universal Scheduling Protocol. Enables platforms to access buyer calendar free/busy data for availability cross-referencing. Platform-scoped capability (dev.usp-protocol.platform.calendar_freebusy).

BusyBlock.title: BusyBlock
BusyBlock.description: An opaque busy time block from the buyer's calendar. Contains only start and end times. Implementations MUST NOT include event details (titles, descriptions, attendees, locations).

start.description: RFC 3339 start of the busy period.

end.description: RFC 3339 end of the busy period.

BuyerFreeBusy.title: BuyerFreeBusy
BuyerFreeBusy.description: Aggregated free/busy data for a buyer across one or more calendar providers. The platform queries the buyer's calendar provider(s) and merges the results into a single set of busy blocks.

buyer_ref.description: Opaque platform-generated buyer correlation ID. MUST NOT contain personally identifiable information.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the buyer (e.g., America/New_York).

queried_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of when the free/busy data was fetched from the calendar provider. Used as a freshness indicator for caching.

busy_blocks.description: Array of busy time blocks merged across all connected calendar providers. An empty array means the buyer has no calendar conflicts in the queried range.

CalendarProviderConfig.title: CalendarProviderConfig
CalendarProviderConfig.description: Informative: configuration reference for a supported calendar provider. Not used in protocol exchanges; included for implementer guidance.

provider_id.description: Well-known provider identifier (google, microsoft, apple) or vendor-prefixed custom provider (e.g., com.fastmail.calendar).

oauth_scope.description: Recommended OAuth scope for free/busy-only access (e.g., https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.freebusy).
